title: Democrats nominate Hakeem Jeffries to be US Speaker of the House
summary: The nomination sets him on the path to become the first black lawmaker to lead the chamber when Democrats take control of the House in January.

blocks.text: Democrats in the US House of Representatives officially nominated Hakeem Jeffries to be Speaker, setting him on the path to become the first black lawmaker to lead the chamber.
The House will elect its new Speaker on 3 January, when the next term begins and Democrats will hold a majority of the seats.
As of Wednesday, Democrats will hold at least 257 seats in the US House next year, with 7 races still uncalled.
His election to the powerful position - the Speaker is in the line of succession to the presidency after the vice-president - is widely expected.
Jeffries was re-elected as the party leader in a 251-11 closed-door vote on Wednesday. He has served as minority leader since 2023.
Despite overwhelming support, Jeffries faced a handful of holdouts from the party's left wing.
